items.question: We are Tier 3, and one Appendix C cell for Tier 3 is empty. Can we drop that control?
items.answer: No. Tier 3 inherits every Tier 2 Appendix C control. An empty Tier 3 cell does not cancel the Tier 2 column.

items.question: Can the project manager set the system to Tier 1 to avoid the extra controls?
items.answer: No. The tier follows the impact, including whether an essential service is involved. It is confirmed by the management route, not chosen to reduce work.

items.question: Our system is Tier 1. Should we still read Appendix C?
items.answer: You should know it exists so you recognise a tier change. You implement Appendix C when the system is Tier 2 or Tier 3. Tier 1 still implements the S17 and G3 baseline.
